units.source_text: 如果说此时我没有某种眩晕，那是谎言。

en.t: If I said that at that moment I felt no kind of dizziness, that would be a lie.
I saw it clearly and in detail.

units.source_text: 然而，我只是停留在成为见证人这一点上。

en.t: Yet I remained only at the point of becoming a witness.

units.source_text: 我从山门的楼上看远方一个神秘的白点，并不是具有这样的一定质量的肉体。

en.t: The mysterious white point I had seen in the distance from the upper floor of the temple gate was not a body possessing this kind of definite mass.

units.source_text: 由于那个印象经过了太长时间的发酵，眼前的乳房是肉体本身，

en.t: Because that impression had fermented over far too long a time, the breasts before my eyes were the body itself,

units.source_text: 只不过变成了一种物质罢了。

en.t: only transformed into a kind of matter.

units.source_text: 而且，它不是要申诉什么或要诱惑什么的肉体，

en.t: Moreover, it was not a body trying to appeal for something or to tempt someone,

units.source_text: 而是存在的乏味的证据，从整个生脱离开来，

en.t: but a tedious proof of existence, detached from the whole of life,

units.source_text: 仅仅呈现在那里的东西而已。

en.t: nothing more than something merely presented there.
